sources.title: Easements (PG62)
sources.verified_claim: PG62 explains registration of easements but does not establish that a sample title benefits from or is burdened by an easement.

sources.title: Practice guide 62: easements
sources.verified_claim: Legal, equitable, implied and prescriptive easement registration rules require the relevant dominant and servient title facts.

sources.title: Notices, restrictions and protection of third-party interests (PG19)
sources.verified_claim: PG19 describes notices and restrictions used to protect third-party interests; candidate-specific entries require the exact title register.

sources.title: Practice guide 19: notices, restrictions and the protection of third-party interests in the register
sources.verified_claim: Restrictions regulate registration of dispositions and notices protect burdens; no such entry is inferred without exact register evidence.

sources.title: HM Land Registry portal: standard restrictions (e-RX1)
sources.verified_claim: Portal procedure for standard restrictions is registration-process evidence, not proof that a candidate title contains a restriction.

sources.title: HM Land Registry portal: non-standard restrictions (e-RX1)
sources.verified_claim: Non-standard restriction application guidance explains wording and evidence; it does not establish a restriction affecting any candidate.

sources.title: Search for land and property information
sources.verified_claim: The property summary can indicate whether restrictive covenants or easements exist, while details require the title register; exact title matching is mandatory.

sources.title: Restrictive Covenants
sources.verified_claim: The dataset identifies registered titles with restrictive covenants but does not provide covenant text; exact candidate title and document matching remain required.
